_comment: Every competitor this harness may run, pinned. `tcb check tools` asserts
each row before a run and records the assertion in the run bundle; a
mismatch is a failed check with the remedy printed, never a recorded
'whatever we found' version.
Three things are asserted per tool, because a version string alone is not
an identity: (1) the version the tool prints, (2) where the resolved
binary comes from (a distribution package, a package from apt.llvm.org, a
prebuilt archive by digest, an opam switch) -- a PyPI `clang-tidy` wheel
and the apt.llvm.org build both print 21.x -- and (3) the resolved path,
so a shim earlier on PATH cannot shadow the pinned install.
`version_policy`: 'exact' -- the printed version must equal `version`;
'distro' -- the version is whatever the pinned distribution ships and
never moves, so it is asserted per distro from `by_distro` and the run
records which one applied (a Debian 12 node and an Ubuntu 24.04 node
measure different cppcheck releases, stably); 'major' -- only the major
must match, the full string is recorded.
`origin.kind`: 'dpkg' -- `dpkg -S <resolved path>` must name `package`
and its installed version must match `package_version` (or, for policy
'distro', the per-distro package version); 'prebuilt' -- the file at
`path` must exist and, when `sha256_of` is set, that archive or binary
must hash to `sha256`; 'opam' -- invoked through `opam exec --`, the
switch's installed package version must match.
aurora-lint itself is pinned in pins/aurora_lint.json and built from
source, so it has no row here.
